title: Agent-first DNS
human_answer_md:
Today most DNS is human-dashboard-first: signup, CAPTCHA, then an API key bolted on later. An **Agentypical** DNS path lets an agent discover the offer, take a capped evaluation, enrol its own credentials, create zones and records programmatically, and only pull a human in for sponsorship or spend authority.

**Honest status:** the Agentypical directory for DNS is still empty — no provider is listed as Certified yet. This page is the stable place to aim an agent while that catalogue grows. If you run a DNS service, publish machine-readable discovery and apply when Certified opens (Phase 2–3).
